core: @neovand/zilion 0.3.0 Z80, compat '0.3', variant 'classic', io hooks on (z80.wgsl({ hooks: { io: true } }))

rules.reason: The Q latch (the flags written by the last instruction) is Zilog-NMOS-specific and not modelled by the classic variant; passed through. Variant zilog-nmos models it.

SCF/CCF take F3/F5 from A only in the classic variant; on a Zilog NMOS Z80 they are ((Q xor F) or A) & 0x28 (variant zilog-nmos). After a wasted DD/FD prefix Q is 0, so the formula there is (F or A) & 0x28. Explained only where the vector follows the NMOS formula and Zilion the A-only formula.
The interrupt-acceptance latches (EI delay; LD A,I/R parity bug) are not modelled: Zilion has no interrupts. Passed through.
